title: The astounding athletic power of quadcopters | Raffaello D'Andrea
summary: In a TEDGlobal talk, Raffaello D'Andrea demonstrates quadcopters that play catch, balance, learn and coordinate, using algorithms that treat them like athletes. It includes Kinect-controlled quads.
why: HN cites it for the live demo of multicopters flying with fewer working rotors.
